scope.surface: Light file detail plus Sidebar Settings footer, Native-safe editor preview, editable textarea, persistent explorer, and second-file selection

productLoss: The first valid light Browser pair exposed a dark 239x32 Sidebar Settings authority raster over the real light footer row.
The Browser Preview compatibility layer now suppresses that dark authority raster only in light theme and restores the real Settings icon and label.
The remaining light full-frame residual stays explicit; this repair does not claim that the full file editor is pixel-identical to Web.
harnessMismatch: A concurrent Native Runtime probe returned no response while another DevTool request targeted the same owned client. All retained Native commands were rerun serially against the process-owned port.

The first hand-written light launcher resolved @lynx-js/lynxtron from the repository root and failed before spawning a process. The retained run resolves from apps/lynxtron and records its exact PID, port, bundle, state directory, and theme.
Web file opening still records one measured outer CDP pointer failure followed by the existing composed-shadow-tree fallback. Lynx-for-Web and Native use real pointer or touch.
intentionalPlatformDelta: The product change is Browser Preview-only because shared Native CSS already hides the light authority raster. Native evidence is correlation and regression coverage, not attribution of a Native product change.
Native uses a textarea editing kernel behind the Native-safe syntax preview rather than the Web Pierre editor island.
acceptedRenderingNoise: Native reports the 539px toolbar content box as 515px because its 12px horizontal padding is excluded from the content measurement; the outer file surface and 40px toolbar allocation remain correct.
The Native explorer is 255px by content width and spans 256px including its one-pixel divider.
classification.evidenceBoundary: Browser before and after use one immutable snapshot, route, selected thread, light theme, 1280x820 viewport, Web authority pixels, target files, and zero-error console. The Lynx application bundle and Web authority bundle hashes are unchanged; the changed Browser Preview host compatibility code supplies the product delta. Exact-bundle Native independently proves light footer semantics and file preview/edit/switch behavior. Native pixels are representative and are not used as a Web parity residual.
